statement: Find an arithmetic-geometric interpretation of the local weights in the enriched count of 3,264 tangent conics.
scope: Nonsingular plane conics tangent to five input plane conics; generic finite complex counts and real constructions have their own hypotheses.
notes: The enriched global count is 1632 hyperbolic planes. Question 3.2 asks for an arithmetic-geometric interpretation of Tr⟨Jac σ(C)⟩ in terms of the solution conic and the five inputs. The 2023 source explicitly asks this question. A focused literature search on 26 October 2026 did not locate a resolution. The global enriched count remains solved; this open refinement concerns its local weights.
